risks.basis: Revenue and split figures are stated in the earnings release (P6); the mechanism is stated in the 10-K risk factor (P2); the size of the exposure is inferred.
risks.claim: Revenue is concentrated in Illinois, where the company's share of terminal income is set by statute; Illinois net revenues were 257,925 of total net revenues of 363,555 in Q3 2026 (table in thousands), and the regulated split is 32.50%.
quotes: If such governing bodies reduce our portion of net terminal income, this may have a material effect on our results of operations and our profit margin.

risks.basis: Risk is stated in the 10-K (P2); the location data come from the release (P6); the link between the Illinois decline and renewal risk is inferred, and management attributes the decline to pruning.
risks.claim: The company depends on winning and renewing location-partner contracts, and the Illinois location count fell to 2,685 from 2,728 a year earlier.
quotes: •We depend heavily on our ability to win, maintain and renew contracts with location partners.

While we have historically experienced high rates of contract extension or renewal, changes in applicable laws, regulations or rules, as well as other factors, may result in declines in contract extensions or renewals.

risks.basis: Balance sheet and cash figures are stated (F1, P6); the risk language is stated (P2); a liquidity problem is not indicated by the evidence, so this is a generic risk.
risks.claim: Debt is a standing risk: debt net of current maturities was 536,094 and current maturities 30,000 (table in thousands) against cash of 294,354, and the 10-K flags indebtedness as a liquidity risk.
quotes: •Our level of indebtedness and the cash required to service it could adversely affect our results of operations and liquidity.

risks.basis: The gain is stated in the release (P6) and the income statement (F2); the share-price driver is stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3); the reversal mechanism is inferred.
risks.claim: Q3 2026 net income growth was helped by a non-operating fair-value gain on contingent earnout shares: a $6 million gain, $3.6 million higher than the Q3 2025 gain.
quotes: Included in Net income is a $6 million gain on the change in the fair value of our contingent earnout shares, which is $3.6 million higher than the gain recognized in Q3 '25.
